entities.name: NodeRadar Pro Architecture
observations: Standalone Avalonia 12 UI (.NET 10) desktop utility by PyPie Studio.
Core engines handle ARP resolution, ICMP sweeps, port scanning, and intrusion detection.
Embedded LiteDB v5 database protected by AES-256 and Windows DPAPI.

entities.name: UI/UX Formatting Standards
observations: 12-Hour AM/PM time formatting standard is mandatory: yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss tt. Never use 24-hour military time.
Dark-Purple Glassmorphic theme with 100% English LTR layout across all views.

entities.name: Security & Cryptography Guardrails
observations: Local credentials and DB passwords encrypted via System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData (DPAPI).
Path sanitization via Path.GetFullPath mandatory for export and updater paths.
